correctness.rationale: Every homomorphism of the derived-central-line two-step nilpotent Leibniz algebras has block matrix [A 0; w s], with arbitrary w∈F_q^2 and A^TBA=sB. For J with B=[[0,1],[0,0]], exactly A=0, two nonzero one-row families, or invertible diagonal A occur. Counting w in/out of row(A) gives rank distribution 1,(q²-1)(2q+1),2q(q-1)(q²-1),q²(q-1)²; nonzero central-image and rank-two maps cannot admit endomorphic inner inverses, but rank-one one-row maps do. The idempotent count is 2q²+2 and regular count q⁴+q²-2q+1. For H, anisotropy forces A=0 when s=0 and A a norm similitude when s≠0, giving 2(q²-1) similitudes and no rank two. Idempotents 2, regular count 1+2q²(q²-1). Direct independent finite-field enumeration checked J at q=2,3 (including exhaustive FGF tests), H at q=3 (exhaustive FGF) and q=5 (ranks/idempotents); analytic argument covers all prime powers in domain.
